gloss: to wrap around; to wind around; to coil around

definitions.gloss: to wrap around; to wind around; to coil around
definitions.explanation: To wind or coil something flexible, such as a bandage, rope, or scarf, tightly around an object or body part so that it stays attached.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦マフラー→マフラー：04533_mafuraa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き⟦{付|つ}けた→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I wrapped a scarf around my neck.

examples.japanese: ⟦{包帯|ほうたい}→包帯：05385_houtai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巻|ま}き⟦{付|つ}けて→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please wrap the bandage around your arm.

examples.japanese: ⟦ロープ→ロープ：27860_roopu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{柱|はしら}→柱：05009_hashira⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{巻|ま}き⟦{付|つ}けた→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I wound the rope tightly around the pillar.
A snake had coiled its body around a tree branch.

notes:
A compound verb formed from ⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧ (to wind, to roll) and ⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ (to attach). Describes the action of wrapping or winding something around an object so that it stays in place.

USAGE:
The pattern is: Thing ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ Object ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巻|ま}き{付|つ}ける
- ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ marks what is being wrapped
- ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ marks what it is wrapped around

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{包帯|ほうたい}→包帯：05385_houtai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{付|つ}ける: to wrap a bandage
- ⟦ロープ→ロープ：27860_roopu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{付|つ}ける: to wind a rope around
- ⟦テープ→テープ：01535_teepu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{付|つ}ける: to wrap tape around
- ⟦マフラー→マフラー：04533_mafuraa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{付|つ}ける: to wrap a scarf around

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧: to wind, to wrap — more general; does not emphasize attachment
- {巻|ま}き⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: to coil around (intransitive) — the thing itself wraps around something
- {絡|から}みつく: to entwine — implies clinging or tangling
